inputs.stored_reports: exact EA-A and EA-B pins in intraday-campaign-readiness-v1.json
inputs.price_archive: original pinned CC price archive in intraday-context-comparison-v2.json
inputs.candidate_population: all original stored signal candidates including old unknown and declined outcomes
inputs.old_outcomes: preserve status and reason as evidence, never use to admit an order
inputs.price_linkage: authenticate every original dated union target chunk against both stored report source digests
inputs.retention: stream one day, retain prices for candidate symbols, preserve all original targets and zero-candidate days

allocation.duplicate_symbol: one held position per symbol across all sleeves

execution_assumptions.session_clocks: unchanged CC assumed KST session open and close including its two dated exceptions
execution_assumptions.candidate_clock: unchanged EA first five-minute OPEN strictly after original decision; cap entry plus sixty minutes before close
execution_assumptions.entry_invalidation: entry_OPEN less than or equal to original structural stop
execution_assumptions.entry_initial_marks: entry OPEN anchor at entry, entry+1min, entry+2min while no held completed close is yet due
execution_assumptions.held_mark: at time t consume exact held minute t-3min CLOSE, with observation end plus two-minute assumed availability
execution_assumptions.idle_clock_compression: preserve session opening, closing and every entry attempt; when no positions remain, skip intervening flat minutes whose NAV and risk state are constant; every held minute and exit remains processed
execution_assumptions.stop: first available held CLOSE at or below original stop schedules min(t+1min,cap) OPEN
execution_assumptions.late_close_after_exit: not decision-relevant to an already closed causal account position; retain old EA complete-path unknown separately

cost_assumptions.cash_rule: charge quantity times entry_OPEN times bps/10000 once at entry; gross proceeds at exit
cost_assumptions.gross_attribution: net PnL plus charged assumed cost for the same filled quantities, not a zero-cost policy rerun

risk.source: CLAUDE Canary limits and existing RiskGateway current-value gate semantics; research reproduction only
risk.anchors: identified NAV before each KST day, Monday week and calendar month's first reference session; initial partial periods begin at fictional capital
risk.threshold_comparison: inclusive current period return, no added latch
risk.breach: decline new entries, continue original scheduled exits

identification.unobserved_original_signals: unknown, not no-signal; preserve original population and coverage
identification.account_claim: hypothetical observed-candidate account conditional on archive availability
identification.first_required_entry_held_or_exit_price_: sticky account indeterminate; preserve known cash, costs, holdings and first unknown time
identification.later_observed_exit: may update conditional modeled holdings and cash but cannot repair unknown history or certify that a missing earlier stop did not fill
identification.post_unknown_holding_observations: still-held plans may consume their remaining registered window and schedule an observed stop; expired unknown exits are not retried or extended

daily_counterfactual.purpose: separate one-day diagnostic when continuous account history may be indeterminate
daily_counterfactual.capital: fresh same initial capital for every original reference day
daily_counterfactual.risk_scope: day-local only; no fabricated weekly or monthly anchors
daily_counterfactual.retain: all identified, incomplete and zero-trade days and original reference weeks
daily_counterfactual.common_comparison: all three policies identified on the same date within one timing and cost scenario, selected after causal replay without future-price order admission

sizing_before_reported_means.labels: exact identified day cash PnL divided by initial capital; paired comparisons use joint-minus-single daily net labels on common dates
sizing_before_reported_means.estimator: existing CC dispersion, maximum naive/session-cluster/five-reference-session circular block bootstrap SE; 2000 draws, Random(0)
sizing_before_reported_means.individual_benchmark: mean charged assumed cost divided by initial capital on the same identified days, expressed in account basis points
sizing_before_reported_means.paired_benchmark: larger of the two compared policies' mean charged cost divided by initial capital on the exact common dates

reporting.continuous: identified prefix and terminal uncertainty; after first unknown all later cash and exit bookkeeping is explicitly conditional, never an identified account history
reporting.daily: all date outcomes plus common-date gross/net returns, costs, filled unique entries, rejection reasons and conditional risk
reporting.weekly: original week denominator retained; incomplete periods have explicit coverage, never fabricated zero trades
reporting.concentration: closed-lot PnL strictly before the first unknown by date and symbol; later conditional closed lots retained separately, never pooled as identified PnL

execution_contract.output_encoding: stream exact JSON and verify stored hash under the same shared budget; return a compact publication receipt rather than duplicate the full account report
execution_contract.qualification_geometry: private preregistered full source geometry and conservative candidate bounds; refuse an actual projection exceeding the qualified bounds before price access, never trim candidates to fit
before_actual: exact private manifest and runtime pins
whole-scale invented WSL compute and GCP journal/transport qualification on the identical full bridge
separate final source and integrity reviews
execution_contract.resource_scope: one cross-host unit; fixed role partitions sum to the unchanged shared CPU and address-space ceilings; no independent allowance per role

bridge_contract.input_scope: unchanged exact two saved report pins and original CC compressed/decoded price pins; no DB, volume archive or existing journal transport
bridge_contract.input_location: exclusive native WSL cache outside every worktree; authenticated mapping preserves original path and pin
bridge_contract.canonical_journal: existing GCP discovery journal only; source-control preparation and invented qualification have distinct paths
bridge_contract.outputs: exclusive native WSL accounts and exclusive GCP evidence copy, both stored and rehashed before canonical completion; compact receipts retain no copied journal span
bridge_contract.wall_clock: one fixed deadline across startup, source checks, transfer, compute, verification, storage and canonical terminal; remote expiry survives PC sleep
bridge_contract.subprocess_cpu: dedicated controller, compute worker, SSH client and GCP coordinator with constrained helper children; count once and retain role readbacks
bridge_contract.memory: sum of hard address-space role caps is at most the shared ceiling; no per-role shared-ceiling duplication
bridge_contract.qualification: same reviewed source/private/runtime identities, full original geometry and candidate bounds, exact input/output transfer and independent verification; no older local-only receipt substitution
bridge_contract.failure: preserve exclusive partial artifacts and remote unresolved marker; disconnect, timeout, missing terminal ACK or resource failure never triggers automatic replay

resource_authorization: Operator explicit choice 2026-10-30: local WSL execution of the same P01-P03 shared CPU600/AS512MiB/wall1200 unit with GCP canonical journal; other EC limits unchanged
